what: Fuzzy Match Between Two Vectors — fuzzy_match
title: Fuzzy Match Between Two Vectors — fuzzy_match
text: function performs fuzzy match two character vectors using various distance methods. calculates similarity scores based selected method returns data frame matches corresponding similarity scores. Optionally, results can sorted similarity scores.

title: Fuzzy Match Between Two Vectors — fuzzy_match
code: fuzzy_match(   x,   y,   method = c("osa", "lv", "dl", "hamming", "lcs", "qgram", "cosine", "jaccard", "jw",     "soundex"),   useBytes = FALSE,   weight = c(d = 1, i = 1, s = 1, t = 1),   q = 1,   p = 0,   bt = 0,   nthread = getOption("sd_num_thread"),   sorted_by_score = TRUE )

title: Fuzzy Match Between Two Vectors — fuzzy_match
text: x character vector. y Another character vector matched `x`. method character string specifying method used calculating string distance. Valid options "osa", "lv", "dl", "hamming", "lcs", "qgram", "cosine", "jaccard", "jw", "soundex". useBytes Logical; `TRUE`, matching done byte--byte rather character--character. weight named numeric vector weights used "osa", "lv", "dl" methods. q integer used "qgram" method. p penalty parameter used "jw" method. bt breaking tie parameter used methods. nthread number threads use computation. sorted_by_score Logical; `TRUE`, results sorted descending similarity scores.

title: Fuzzy Match Between Two Vectors — fuzzy_match
text: `data.frame` containing original elements `x` `y`, similarity scores, index positions.         `sorted_by_score` `TRUE`, data frame sorted similarity scores descending order.

title: Fuzzy Match Between Two Vectors — fuzzy_match
code: x <- "apple" y <- c("ape", "bandana", "berry") fuzzy_match(x, y, method = "jaccard") #>       x       y similarity_scores index #> 1 apple     ape         0.7083333     1 #> 2 apple bandana         0.0000000     2 #> 3 apple   berry         0.0000000     3
